analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($1.54) vs SMA5/20/50 ($1.18/$1.07/$1.09) — Confirms short-to-mid-term trend outperformance.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($1.15/$1.28) — Maintains mid-to-long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (25.2%) + Current price level is high relative to historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (33.9→87.1) — Confirms exit from oversold and entry into overbought territory.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0035→0.0470) — Continues to improve, diagnosing bullish expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near upper band $1.32) — Breaks upper band, with band width expanding to 46.44%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($1.53) — Aligns with 5-day high, acting as short-term support.
· Swing resistance ($1.55) — Previous high, potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day high renewal, 20-day high renewal) — Sustains uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (4.25x) — Surge strengthens bullish momentum, increasing reliability.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) — Buy entry conditions met with RSI entering overbought and 5-day high renewed for 3 consecutive days.
